: Stantec is unable to provide status updates on your job submissions via email or phone. You can find out the status of your job submissions by logging into your online candidate profile, simply click on the link within your profile to view your respective job submissions. You must apply to a posted position on Stantec's website to be consider for that position, Stantec does not accept applications/resumes via email.APPLICATION STATUSJob Submissions
